title: Fish Tales Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Fish Tales at 39 Rosewalk in Seaside is a newly redecorated, darling cottage with its funky collection of all kinds of fish. It sits in the trees in the picture perfect town of Seaside, Florida (the little town seen in the movie, The Truman Show).
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 4 houses down from 30A with easy access to the TUPELO private beach access in Seaside - You will have a total of 6 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Quiet, private location within Seaside on Rosewalk - Walking distance to the Seaside shops and restaurants - Fully stocked kitchen - Two adult beach cruiser bikes - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. ADDITIONAL ADD-ONS: -**There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -**Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($100 fee applies at booking) Fish Tales Cottage has pickled wood floors and open living area with vaulted ceiling; that includes a love seat, 40" flat screen television, and a window seat for relaxing and napping. The front porch sits in a treed park and has comfy chairs for reading and visiting after a day in the sun at the beach. The galley kitchen with new oven and newly redecorated adjoining dining area for six is the perfect space to enjoy a couple of your beach dinners in . The downstairs bedroom offers a daybed with trundle that comfortably accommodates 2. There is a flat screen TV in this room with DVD capabilities only (perfect for kids). Just off this downstairs bedroom is the full bath with claw foot tub and shower. There is an additional shower outside as well. The upstairs master suite offers a king bed with additional full bed raised a couple of steps. This raised space is perfect for reading or watching TV. A flat screen TV, love seat, and closet space will ensure you have all the comforts of home at this beach getaway. A few steps up in the tower room with game table and seating for 4, you will see fabulous views of sunsets, gulf, and the famous Seaside rooftops. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (sleeps 6) 1st floor- Bedroom 1: Daybed with trundle (TV access with DVD capability only) Kitchen, dining area and great room with Cable TV 2nd floor- Bedroom 2: KING bed plus an additional full bed a couple of steps above King bed (TV) Fish Tales is on one of the many walking paths and is only a half block from swimming pools, fitness center, tennis courts, children's playground, croquet and basketball courts, and bike rentals. Seaside is a beach town with an old-fashioned feel, lots of white picket fences, and winding footpaths. There are activities almost too numerous to mention. There are twilight concerts and movies on the grass, bike rides on the narrow streets, dancing at Bud and Alley's, a different, gorgeous sunset every night, yoga, tennis, croquet, wine festivals, live theater, frolicking on the beach, Camp Seaside, Kids Night Out, long peaceful walks, crabbing in the Gulf, a visit to the pristine, white Chapel, searching for shells, eating ice cream cones, swimming and floating in the crystal, clear water. Nearby are golf courses, miles of bike paths, fishing, kayaking and canoeing in dune lakes. Those lucky enough to find Seaside come back again and again. IMPORTANT DETAILS ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
